subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should channel-triggered lifecycle resets use a narrow gateway-owned reset seam instead of publishing the branch's reduced Plugin SDK lifecycle-reset API?
rationale: This choice establishes a permanent public API and cross-plugin authorization boundary; code review can identify the unsafe current call path but cannot choose the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Gateway-owned reset seam
options.body: Expose a narrow core request for Teams while retaining lifecycle cleanup and harness authorization in the gateway service.

options.title: Sponsor Plugin SDK reset
options.body: Publish the plugin-facing reset only after defining and accepting its cleanup, authorization, and compatibility semantics.

recommendation.title: Gateway-owned reset seam
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow core request for Teams while retaining lifecycle cleanup and harness authorization in the gateway service.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and the strongest history-backed owner of the pluggable harness boundary and intended Teams lifecycle scope.
